label: EMI exposure
description: Percentage of enrolled school-going children in English-medium instruction
notes: Main endogenous regressor.

label: Linguistic distance
description: Population-weighted linguistic distance from Hindi using 2001 mother tongue data
notes: Deprecated compatibility alias for the legacy top-three construction; not the preferred excluded instrument.

label: Consumption growth
description: Percent change in district average consumption from 2007-08 to 2017-18
notes: Legacy outcome; planned replacement/robustness is log consumption difference.

label: Log consumption difference
description: Log difference in district average consumption from 2007-08 to 2017-18
notes: Planned FD-2SLS outcome.

label: Real consumption per person 2007-08
description: Person-weighted district mean of household consumption after state-sector sub-round deflation
source: NSS 64 Block 3 and project price system
notes: Constructed before district aggregation; intended revised outcome input.

label: Real consumption per person 2017-18
description: Person-weighted district mean of household UMPCE after state-sector sub-round deflation
source: NSS 75 Block 3 and project price system
notes: Single-shot UMPCE measurement limitation remains after deflation.

label: Mean price deflator 2007-08
description: Person-weighted district mean of attached household state-sector sub-round deflators
notes: Diagnostic.

label: Mean price deflator 2017-18
description: Person-weighted district mean of attached household state-sector sub-round deflators
notes: Diagnostic.

label: Log population in 2001
description: Natural log of total Census 2001 district population
notes: Predetermined control.

label: Urban population share in 2001
description: Urban residents as a percentage of total district population
notes: Predetermined control.

label: Secondary-plus share in 2001
description: Population age 7 and above with matric or higher attainment as a percentage of population age 7 and above
notes: Predetermined control.

label: Scheduled Caste share in 2001
description: Scheduled Caste population as a percentage of total population
notes: Predetermined control.

label: Scheduled Tribe share in 2001
description: Scheduled Tribe population as a percentage of total population
notes: Predetermined control.

label: Muslim share in 2001
description: Muslim population as a percentage of total population
notes: Predetermined control.

label: Agricultural worker share in 2001
description: Cultivators and agricultural labourers as a percentage of total workers
notes: Predetermined control.

label: Dependency ratio in 2001
description: Population age 0-14 and 65-plus as a percentage of population age 15-64
notes: Predetermined control.

label: Household electricity access in 2001
description: Households using electricity for lighting as a percentage of households
notes: Predetermined control.

label: Log population density in 2001
description: Natural log of persons per square kilometre
notes: Predetermined control.

label: Mean nonzero linguistic distance
description: Speaker-weighted mean Shastry distance among mapped speakers whose distance exceeds zero
notes: Preferred scalar candidate for Phase 2 relevance testing.

label: Distant-language share
description: Share of all C-16 speaker mass mapped to linguistic distance three or above
universe: mapped Census-2001 C-16 mother-tongue speaker mass
notes: Alternative excluded instrument.

label: Distance-zero language share
description: Share of all C-16 speaker mass mapped to distance zero
universe: mapped Census-2001 C-16 mother-tongue speaker mass
notes: Omitted compositional reference in distance-share specifications.

label: Distance-one language share
description: Share of all C-16 speaker mass mapped to distance one
universe: mapped Census-2001 C-16 mother-tongue speaker mass
notes: Proposed excluded instrument.

label: Distance-two language share
description: Share of all C-16 speaker mass mapped to distance two
universe: mapped Census-2001 C-16 mother-tongue speaker mass
notes: Proposed excluded instrument.

label: Distance-three language share
description: Share of all C-16 speaker mass mapped to distance three
universe: mapped Census-2001 C-16 mother-tongue speaker mass
notes: Proposed excluded instrument.

label: Distance-four language share
description: Share of all C-16 speaker mass mapped to distance four
universe: mapped Census-2001 C-16 mother-tongue speaker mass
notes: Proposed excluded instrument.

label: Distance-five language share
description: Share of all C-16 speaker mass mapped to distance five
universe: mapped Census-2001 C-16 mother-tongue speaker mass
notes: Proposed excluded instrument.

label: Hindi share
description: Share of all C-16 speaker mass in the Hindi language group
notes: Reported separately to address the distance-zero nonmonotonicity.

label: Urdu share
description: Share of all C-16 speaker mass in the Urdu language group
notes: Reported separately while treating Hindi and Urdu as zero-distance languages.

label: Hindi and Urdu share
description: Share of all C-16 speaker mass in Hindi or Urdu
notes: Primary combined zero-distance language-composition control candidate.

label: Native English share
description: Share of all C-16 speaker mass in the English language group
notes: Intentional special category excluded from Shastry-style weighted-distance means and available as a separate composition control.

label: Legacy top-three linguistic distance
description: Speaker-weighted mean distance among the three largest mapped mother tongues
notes: Retained only for descriptive comparison with the former instrument.

label: Enrollment rate in 2007-08
description: Survey-weighted share of age-eligible children who are enrolled
notes: Extensive-margin treatment component; primary ages 5-19.

label: EMI share among enrolled children in 2007-08
description: Survey-weighted English-medium share among enrolled children with known medium
notes: Canonical intensive-margin replacement for the historical EMIE field.

label: EMI exposure among all children in 2007-08
description: Survey-weighted English-medium enrolled share among all age-eligible children
notes: Preferred future endogenous treatment; primary ages 5-19.

label: Unknown medium among enrolled children
description: Survey-weighted enrolled share with unavailable medium of instruction
notes: Coverage diagnostic; unknown medium is not classified as non-English.

label: Private enrollment share in 2007-08
description: Survey-weighted private aided or unaided share among enrolled children with known institution management
notes: Household-side realized institution choice; unknown management remains excluded from the denominator.

label: Unknown school management among enrolled children
description: Survey-weighted enrolled share with unavailable or not-known institution management
notes: Coverage diagnostic; unknown management is never classified as public.

label: EMI share among public-school children in 2007-08
description: Survey-weighted English-medium share among enrolled government/local-body children with known medium
notes: Conditional medium choice within public schooling.

label: EMI share among private-school children in 2007-08
description: Survey-weighted English-medium share among enrolled private aided/unaided children with known medium
notes: Conditional medium choice within private schooling.

label: EMI share among private-aided children in 2007-08
description: Survey-weighted English-medium share among enrolled private-aided children with known medium
notes: Appendix institution-management sensitivity measure.

label: EMI share among private-unaided children in 2007-08
description: Survey-weighted English-medium share among enrolled private-unaided children with known medium
notes: Appendix institution-management sensitivity measure.

label: Public EMI exposure among all children in 2007-08
description: Survey-weighted share of age-eligible children enrolled in public English-medium schooling
notes: One cell of the household-side management-by-medium decomposition.

label: Public non-EMI exposure among all children in 2007-08
description: Survey-weighted share of age-eligible children enrolled in public non-English-medium schooling
notes: One cell of the household-side management-by-medium decomposition.

label: Private EMI exposure among all children in 2007-08
description: Survey-weighted share of age-eligible children enrolled in private English-medium schooling
notes: One cell of the household-side management-by-medium decomposition.

label: Private non-EMI exposure among all children in 2007-08
description: Survey-weighted share of age-eligible children enrolled in private non-English-medium schooling
notes: One cell of the household-side management-by-medium decomposition.

label: Unknown school classification among all children
description: Survey-weighted share of age-eligible children enrolled with unknown medium or institution management
notes: Residual classification mass that completes the four-cell accounting identity without imputing missing management or medium.

label: Literacy share in 2001
description: Literate population as a percentage of population age 7 and above
notes: Expanded Census-control diagnostic.

label: Worker share in 2001
description: Total workers as a percentage of total population
notes: Expanded Census-control diagnostic.

label: Cultivator share of workers in 2001
description: Cultivators as a percentage of total workers
notes: Expanded occupational-structure diagnostic.

label: Agricultural labourer share of workers in 2001
description: Agricultural labourers as a percentage of total workers
notes: Expanded occupational-structure diagnostic.

label: Glottolog linguistic distance
description: Speaker-weighted mean Glottolog 5.3 edge distance from Hindi among accepted non-Hindi/Urdu, non-English mother tongues
notes: Alternative genealogical-distance basis; taxonomy is Glottolog 5.3 and is not labeled as Shastry/Ethnologue node distance.

label: Glottolog mapped nonreference share
description: Share of non-Hindi/Urdu, non-English C-16 speaker mass with an accepted Census-Glottolog mapping
notes: Construction-specific mapping coverage used by Glottolog robustness specifications.

label: Glottolog unresolved nonreference share
description: Share of non-Hindi/Urdu, non-English C-16 speaker mass without an accepted Census-Glottolog mapping
notes: Complements Glottolog mapped nonreference share.

label: Dyen/Shastry lexical distance
description: Speaker-weighted mean of 100 minus percent cognates with Hindi among mapped non-Hindi/Urdu, non-English mother tongues
source: Census 2001 C-16 + Dyen et al. (1997) + Shastry (2008)
notes: Strict historical lexical robustness basis. Direct Dyen Hindi cognate shares are used where indexed; non-Indo-European languages use Shastry's documented 5 percent common-words convention. Missing Indo-European leaves remain unresolved.

label: Dyen mapped nonreference share
description: Share of non-Hindi/Urdu, non-English C-16 speaker mass with a Dyen/Shastry lexical-distance assignment
source: Census 2001 C-16 + Dyen et al. (1997) + Shastry (2008)
notes: Construction-specific mapping coverage for Dyen lexical robustness specifications.

label: Dyen unresolved nonreference share
description: Share of non-Hindi/Urdu, non-English C-16 speaker mass without a Dyen/Shastry lexical-distance assignment
source: Census 2001 C-16 + Dyen et al. (1997) + Shastry (2008)
notes: Complements Dyen mapped nonreference share.

label: Shastry distance, lower adjudication sensitivity
description: Speaker-weighted nonzero Shastry distance under the joint minimum plausible degree recorded for every reviewed ambiguous mother tongue
source: Census 2001 C-16 + frozen Shastry adjudication ledger
notes: Stress-test construction only. Preferred published/accepted assignments are supplemented or shifted to the minimum degree in sensitivity_degrees; not a new preferred instrument.

label: Shastry distance, upper adjudication sensitivity
description: Speaker-weighted nonzero Shastry distance under the joint maximum plausible degree recorded for every reviewed ambiguous mother tongue
source: Census 2001 C-16 + frozen Shastry adjudication ledger
notes: Stress-test construction only. Preferred published/accepted assignments are supplemented or shifted to the maximum degree in sensitivity_degrees; not a new preferred instrument.

label: Mapped share under Shastry adjudication sensitivity
description: Share of district speaker mass with a finite degree in the frozen lower/upper adjudication sensitivity mappings
source: Census 2001 C-16 + frozen Shastry adjudication ledger
notes: Lower and upper scenarios have identical mapped support by construction.
